title: Walmart Welcomes AI Shopping Agents Unlike Amazon
excerpt: Walmart introduces new technology allowing AI agents to make purchases for customers, taking a different path than Amazon.
body_html:
Major retailers are taking contrasting approaches to artificial intelligence shopping assistants. While Amazon moves to block AI agents from operating on its platform, Walmart is embracing the technology.

Walmart has introduced new capabilities that enable AI agents to complete purchases on behalf of users. The system includes built-in controls designed to manage spending limits and handle transaction approvals.
